name: Congenital Pulmonary Airway Malformation Type 2

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Radiologic and histopathologic diagnosis of CPAM

criteria.description: Presence of multiple small cystic lesions (0.5-2 cm) within the affected lung lobe on prenatal or postnatal imaging
Histopathologic confirmation of abnormal bronchiolar-like structures with cystic dilatation and adenomatoid proliferation
Exclusion of other congenital lung malformations such as bronchopulmonary sequestration or bronchogenic cyst

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic cystic lesions on imaging plus histopathologic confirmation of type 2 CPAM features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Prenatal ultrasound and fetal MRI are key for early detection; postnatal CT scan aids in detailed assessment.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Multiple small cystic lesions in lung parenchyma
pathognomonic.notes: Typically localized to a single lobe
searchTerms: multiple tiny cystic spots in lungs

common.symptomName: Decreased breath sounds over affected lung
searchTerms: reduced breath sounds over lung area

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; possible leukocytosis during infections
imaging: Prenatal ultrasound showing echogenic lung mass with cystic components
Chest CT scan revealing multiple small cysts (0.5-2 cm) confined to one lobe
Fetal MRI for detailed lesion characterization
genetic: No consistent genetic mutation identified; sporadic occurrence
other: Histopathology showing bronchiolar-type cysts with adenomatoid proliferation

distinguishingFeatures: Overinflation of a lobe without cystic structures

redFlags: Severe neonatal respiratory distress requiring ventilation
Rapidly enlarging cystic lung mass causing mediastinal shift
references: Stocker JT. Congenital pulmonary airway malformation: a new name for and an expanded classification of congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation of the lung. Histopathology. 2002.
Langston C. New concepts in the pathology of congenital lung malformations. Semin Pediatr Surg. 2003.
Orphanet: Congenital pulmonary airway malformation type 2 (ORPHA:280840)
